# Link Picker

## Summary
Edits a linksTo value in place: shows the linked card's title (and an optional detail line), and opens a searchable popover over one card type to change it.

## API
Args: `label`, `value?: CardDef`, `emptyLabel`, `detail?`, `cardClass` (a class, so subclasses are included), `context?`, `realms`, `onChange`.

## Usage
```ts
import { LinkPicker } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/service-desk/components/link-picker';

<LinkPicker @label='Assignee' @value={{@model.assignee}} @emptyLabel='Unassigned' @cardClass={{SupportAgent}} @realms={{this.realms}} @context={{@context}} @onChange={{this.assign}} />
```
Built on the catalog Popover. Ticket Workspace uses it for assignee, queue, category and policy.

## Non-goals
Not a field editor for many-to-many links, and not a general search box; it picks one card of one type.
